summary: The migration planning guide fully satisfies all brief requirements, boundaries, and workflow specifications. It methodically covers legacy record auditing and classification, relational data sanitization and mapping, pilot imports with line-by-line verification, and phased cutovers with fallback and parallel run protocols. Citations to the ISO/IAF external providers guidance and the ICC Supplier Quality module page are factual and properly contextualized, and all workflow parameters, roles, decisions, records, exceptions, evaluation criteria, and labeled illustrative examples are present without unassigned FAQ sections.
decisions: Determine which records deserve migration into the live database
Determine how each legacy column maps to a field in the target schema and what transformation rules apply
Determine whether the import is accurate enough to approve the script for the full load
Issue final go or no-go cutover authorization across all plants or staged sites
